maldives.lead: The Maldives — about 1,200 islands in 26 atolls of the Indian Ocean. Resorts each take an island of their own: water and beach villas, lagoons, reefs.
maldives.f1: Transfer from Malé airport by seaplane, speedboat or domestic flight, depending on the atoll.
maldives.f2: Dry season and calmest weather — roughly November to April.
maldives.f3: Popular: water villas, snorkelling and diving, all-inclusive programmes.

seychelles.lead: The Seychelles — an archipelago of 115 islands. The main ones are Mahé, Praslin and La Digue: granite boulders, beaches and tropical nature.
seychelles.f1: The international airport is on Mahé; ferries and domestic flights connect the islands.
seychelles.f2: A year-round destination; the trade winds change around May and October.
seychelles.f3: Popular: the beaches of La Digue and Praslin, nature parks, pool villas.

mauritius.lead: Mauritius — a volcanic island ringed by a coral reef. Lagoons, mountains and long beaches; the Le Morne peninsula in the south-west.
mauritius.f1: The international airport is in the south-east; resorts are reached by road.
mauritius.f2: Southern-hemisphere summer is November to April; winter (May–October) is mild and drier.
mauritius.f3: Popular: lagoons and reefs, golf, kitesurfing at Le Morne.
